steps.js: await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,90000)); const a=performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(e=>e.name.includes('/api/')); const shots=a.filter(e=>/\/api\/shots\/ep\d+-S\d+(\?|$)/.test(e.name)); const eps=new Set(shots.map(e=>(e.name.match(/ep\d+/)||[''])[0])); let maxConc=0; for(const s of shots){ const c=shots.filter(o=>o.startTime<s.startTime+s.duration && o.startTime+o.duration>s.startTime).length; maxConc=Math.max(maxConc,c);} return {apiTotal:a.length, shotFetches:shots.length, shotEpisodes:[...eps], maxConcurrentShotFetch:maxConc, slowOver5s:a.filter(e=>e.duration>5000).map(e=>new URL(e.name).pathname+' '+Math.round(e.duration)).slice(0,5), summaryFetches:a.filter(e=>/episodes\/summary/.test(e.name)).length};
